teaser.en: Its Digo name means simply 'bitter', and for generations its sap tipped the arrows of coastal hunters.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'uchungu' tu, na kwa vizazi vingi utomvu wake ulipakwa kwenye ncha za mishale ya wawindaji wa pwani.

summary.en: *Utsungu* is the arrow-poison tree, an evergreen shrub with fragrant flowers and deadly sap. It was a source of arrow poison and of straight wood for spear shafts.
summary.sw: *Utsungu* ni mti uitwao kwa Kiingereza *arrow-poison tree*, kichaka kisichopukutika majani chenye maua yenye harufu nzuri na utomvu wa sumu kali ya kuua. Ulikuwa chanzo cha sumu ya mishale na cha mbao zilizonyooka za kutengenezea mipini ya mikuki.

about.en:
*Utsungu* is an evergreen shrub or small tree with stiff, glossy, leathery leaves that look almost polished. The flowers are white to pink, tubular and sweetly scented, borne in dense clusters along the stems. They are followed by plum-like berries that ripen purple-black.

It looks like an attractive garden shrub, which is part of the danger: the whole plant is highly poisonous.
about.sw:
*Utsungu* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutika majani, wenye majani magumu, yanayong'aa na kama ngozi, yanayoonekana karibu kama yamesuguliwa. Maua ni meupe hadi ya waridi, yenye umbo la mrija na harufu tamu, yakiwa yamesongamana kwa vishada kando ya mashina. Baada yake huja matunda kama plamu yanayoiva kuwa zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi.

Unaonekana kama kichaka cha kupendeza cha bustanini, na hiyo ni sehemu ya hatari yake: mmea mzima una sumu kali.

where.en: *Utsungu* grows in rocky bushland, on dry, stony ground in the coastal hinterland. The scented flowers make it easier to notice when it is blooming.
where.sw: *Utsungu* hukua katika nyika ya vichaka yenye mawe, kwenye ardhi kavu ya mawe katika maeneo ya bara ya pwani. Maua yake yenye harufu hurahisisha kuuona unapochanua.

uses.en:
*Utsungu* was a source of arrow poison. The plant is rich in cardiac glycosides, compounds that act on the heart, which made poisoned arrows effective for hunting. Its straight stems were also used for spear shafts.

Today hunting with poisoned arrows is rare, but the knowledge of *utsungu* as a poison plant remains.
uses.sw:
*Utsungu* ulikuwa chanzo cha sumu ya mishale. Mmea huu una kiasi kikubwa cha glikosidi za moyo (*cardiac glycosides*), kemikali zinazoathiri moyo, jambo lililoifanya mishale iliyotiwa sumu kufaa katika uwindaji. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka pia yalitumika kutengeneza mipini ya mikuki.

Leo uwindaji kwa mishale yenye sumu ni nadra, lakini maarifa kuhusu *utsungu* kama mmea wa sumu bado yapo.

culture.en: The name *utsungu* means 'bitter', and its extract is both bitter and poisonous. The name is a warning built into the language.
culture.sw: Jina *utsungu* lina maana ya 'uchungu', na dondoo lake ni chungu na lina sumu pia. Jina hili ni onyo lililojengwa ndani ya lugha.

names.en: Digo: *utsungu*, 'bitter'. Giriama: *utungu*. English: arrow-poison tree. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Acokanthera schimperi*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *utsungu*, 'uchungu'. Kigiriama: *utungu*. Kiingereza: *arrow-poison tree*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Acokanthera schimperi*.

reason.en: Another poisonous shrub of the dogbane family
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha sumu cha familia ya oleander

reason.en: Its sticks were used for arrow shafts
reason.sw: Mganda simba, ambao vijiti vyake vilitumika kutengeneza mishale
Mchunga, mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na uchungu

definition.en: A deadly poisonous latex, used as arrow poison. The tree was brought to the coast fairly recently by the Giriama.
definition.sw: Utomvu wenye sumu kali ya kuua, unaotumika kama sumu ya mishale. Mti huu uliletwa pwani na Wagiriama hivi karibuni kiasi.
